title: Isometric City Square
description: A detailed isometric view of a vibrant fantasy city featuring a central checkered plaza with a fountain, surrounded by purple waterways, ivy-covered buildings, a prominent clock tower, industrial smokestacks, and various vehicles and figures populating the streets.
prompt: Isometric view of a charming fantasy city with a large central plaza paved in blue and white checkered tiles containing a circular fountain. Purple rivers and canals run through the town, crossed by small bridges. Buildings include a tall beige clock tower, ivy-covered residential blocks, brick industrial factories with smokestacks emitting purple smoke, and shops. Small vehicles, people, and glowing elements are scattered throughout the streets under soft daylight.
